title: "Interactive Dashboard"
format:
  html:
    self-contained: true
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)

data <- read.csv("data/final_dataset.csv")

p <- ggplot(data, aes(
  x = economics_uncertainty_index,
  y = Repetition_Score,
  text = Country
)) +
  geom_point(color = "steelblue", size = 3) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Economic Uncertainty vs Repetitive Listening",
    x = "Economic Uncertainty Index",
    y = "Repetition Score"
  )

ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")
